interruption.text: Secure tier rows are on-demand node rentals; spot tier rows are interruptible capacity.

manual_snapshot.reason: Collected by scripts/collect_lium.py (own workflow, lium-collect.yml), not by the daily page refresh; auto-holds after 7 days without a new capture.

market_note: Lium is a GPU marketplace (Bittensor subnet 51). Each row is the cheapest available node per model and tier in the public nodes feed, with free-GPU stock and the minimum rental size of that node. Lium's pricing.json reference prices are not used.
